stories.story_fr: Corpay a annoncé un partenariat stratégique avec Mastercard.
stories.story_en: Corpay announced a strategic partnership with Mastercard.
stories.quote: We announced an exciting investment and strategic partnership with Mastercard.

stories.story_fr: Corpay prévoit d'investir 500 M$ avec TPG pour acquérir AvidXchange.
stories.story_en: Corpay plans to invest $500 million alongside TPG to acquire AvidXchange.
stories.quote: We announced our plan to invest $500 million, alongside TPG, to acquire AvidXchange.

stories.short: Croissance du segment Corporate Payments Q1 2025
stories.story_fr: Le segment Corporate Payments a progressé de 19 % au premier trimestre 2025.
stories.story_en: The Corporate Payments segment grew 19% in Q1 2025.

stories.story_fr: Corpay a enregistré des revenus records au quatrième trimestre 2024.
stories.story_en: Corpay posted record revenues in Q4 2024.
stories.quote: All-time record revenues and adjusted net income.

stories.story_fr: Deux acquisitions importantes ont été réalisées au cours de l'année 2024.
stories.story_en: Two significant acquisitions were completed during 2024.
stories.quote: We delivered Corporate Payments growth of 20% for the full year, and we made meaningful advances to scale our Corporate Payments business, with two significant acquisitions during the year.
